status: FROZEN 2026-10-08 on the commit that adds this record. HOLDOUT NOT RUN.
scope: A test-harness-only concurrency revision. The WWAlignEstimate implementation, estimator parameters, synthetic calibration recipes, independent clock truth, scoring, counts and gate are unchanged from m2-freeze-estimator. The original freeze, M2 holdout, and evidence remain intact.
pinnedTreesRule: Paths are relative to Packages/WaveWranglerKit. The source tree must remain byte-identical to m2-freeze-estimator. HoldoutTests recomputes both working-tree IDs. Any future source or test-tree change requires another dated freeze revision and fresh disjoint holdout.

testConcurrency.raisedWindow: A requested value above the default requires WW_ESTIMATOR_CONCURRENCY_GRANT to exactly match WW_ESTIMATOR_MAX_CONCURRENCY. Values above four are rejected.
testConcurrency.scheduling: Calibration adds at most the configured number of cases to its task group and replenishes one slot per completed case. Scenario tests are serialized, and scripts/test.sh disables parallel test execution during the estimator pass.

estimator.outputs: Unchanged: acousticConsistentProposal or typed abstention with an unsupported map; never clockApproved.

recipeAndTruth.recipe: Unchanged synthetic deterministic in-memory generator, strata, track durations, sample rates, overlap, acoustic delays, noise distributions, and group-clock starts from the original freeze.
recipeAndTruth.truth: Unchanged independent affine clock truth with the same offset, ppm, and discontinuity distributions. Every scored residual remains against clock truth, never the estimator fit.
recipeAndTruth.seedDerivation: Unchanged SplitMix64.caseSeed: first output from master XOR FNV-1a64(UTF-8 stratum name) XOR (case index &* 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15).
recipeAndTruth.disjointness: Revision-2 holdout seeds are asserted unique and disjoint from the original calibration and the passed m2-freeze-estimator holdout before the new holdout renders or estimates cases.

priorHoldout.status: Previously passed under m2-freeze-estimator; preserved and not rerun.

holdout.status: NOT RUN. Run once on the clean commit containing this record.

gate.authority: Identical to m2-freeze-estimator. No gate is lowered or weakened.

holdoutProcedure.when: Once only, after this record and its pinned test tree are committed cleanly.
holdoutProcedure.command: WW_ESTIMATOR_HOLDOUT=1 WW_ESTIMATOR_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2 swift test --package-path Packages/WaveWranglerKit --scratch-path .build/swiftpm --jobs 4 --no-parallel --filter HoldoutTests
holdoutProcedure.report: Preserve the unedited log, commit SHA, host/toolchain, start load, test/helper CPU, exact counts, every case line, clock-residual p95/max and GateEvaluation summary. Do not rerun or lower counts after failure.
